title: Determinants and unstable cores in sequential distributive phosphorylation
summary: Vassena and Stadler (arXiv:2308.11486v3, Supplementary Example D) conjectured that sequential distributive phosphorylation cycles have only unstable-positive cores and that every invertible child-selection matrix has determinant of absolute value one. The determinant assertion is proved, and the restriction to unstable-positive cores is disproved. In the n-site cycle, every child-selection matrix has determinant 0, 1 or -1.
